from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,random,statistics,fcntl,time,resource,hashlib
p=Path(__file__).parent;rows=[];variants=['baseline','control','signed_den','diff_den']
lock=open('/tmp/sirkit_performance_cpu4.lock','w');fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
dest=p/'run-full';dest.touch()
for cfg in ['default','native']:
 for mode in ['random','equal','ascending','descending','endpoints','near']:
  data=(p/f'input-{mode}-200000.txt').read_bytes();expected=None
  for repeat in range(9):
   order=variants.copy();random.Random(repeat+98432).shuffle(order)
   for name in order:
    src=p/f'full-{cfg}-{name if name!="control" else "baseline"}'
    with open(dest,'wb')as f:f.write(src.read_bytes())
    dest.chmod(0o755)
    before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);start=time.perf_counter()
    q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','4',str(dest)],input=data,capture_output=True)
    stop=time.perf_counter();after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);assert q.returncode==0,q.stderr
    digest=hashlib.sha256(q.stdout).hexdigest()
    if expected is None:expected=digest
    assert digest==expected
    rows.append(dict(cfg=cfg,n=200000,mode=mode,variant=name,repeat=repeat,cpu_seconds=after.ru_utime+after.ru_stime-before.ru_utime-before.ru_stime,wall_seconds=stop-start,output_sha256=digest))
   print(cfg,mode,repeat,flush=True)
  vals={name:statistics.median(x['cpu_seconds']for x in rows if(x['cfg'],x['mode'],x['variant'])==(cfg,mode,name))for name in variants}
  print('MEDIANS',cfg,mode,{name:round(v/vals['baseline'],4)for name,v in vals.items()},flush=True)
  (p/'final-raw.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
summary=[]
for cfg in ['default','native']:
 for mode in ['random','equal','ascending','descending','endpoints','near']:
  vals={name:statistics.median(x['cpu_seconds']for x in rows if(x['cfg'],x['mode'],x['variant'])==(cfg,mode,name))for name in variants}
  summary.append(dict(cfg=cfg,n=200000,mode=mode,median_seconds=vals,ratio={k:v/vals['baseline']for k,v in vals.items()}))
(p/'final-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
